records.abstract_en: We analyze optimal procurement contracts when suppliers learn about project costs over time and retain an ex-post right to exit. In the first period, the firm observes a private signal on the likelihood of high costs; in the second, it learns the realized cost type and decides whether to continue or exercise its outside option. We show that when exit opportunities are sufficiently attractive, the optimal mechanism pools all first-period signals and reduces to a cost-plus contract, with payments tied only to realized, verifiable costs. Attempts to elicit cost forecasts ex-ante backfire: firms strategically under-report expectations, triggering exit in high-cost states and generating overruns. This provides a mechanism-based interpretation of cost overruns as failures of incentive design. Finally, we demonstrate that more generous outside options can raise procurement costs and lower firm profits, identifying conditions where limiting exit rights is ex-ante Pareto improving. (JEL D82, D86, H57)
records.abstract_cn: 当供应商随着时间的推移了解项目成本并保留事后退出权时，我们会分析最佳采购合同。在 第一 期间，公司观察到有关高成本可能性的私人信号；在 第二 中，它了解已实现的成本类型并决定是否继续或行使其外部选项。我们表明，当退出机会足够有吸引力时，最优机制会汇集所有 第一 周期信号，并简化为成本加成合同，付款仅与已实现的、可验证的成本挂钩。事前进行成本预测的尝试适得其反：企业战略性地低报预期，引发高成本州的退出并产生超支。这提供了基于机制的成本超支解释为激励设计的失败。最后，我们证明，更慷慨的外部选择会提高采购成本并降低公司利润，并确定限制退出权是事前帕累托改进的条件。 (JEL D82、D86、H57)

records.title_en: Reduced strategies and cognitive hierarchies in the extensive and normal form
records.title_cn: 广泛和正常形式的减少策略和认知层次
records.abstract_en: In a recent paper, Lin and Palfrey (2024) developed a theory of cognitive hierarchies (CH) in sequential games and observed that this solution concept is not reduced-normal-form invariant. In this paper I qualify and explain this observation. I show that the CH model is normal-form invariant, and that the differences arising from the application of the CH model to the reduced normal form depend only on how randomization by level-0 types is modeled. Indeed, while the uniform behavior strategy in the extensive form yields the uniform mixed strategy in the normal form, the latter does not correspond to the uniform randomization in the reduced normal form, because different reduced strategies may correspond to sets of equivalent strategies with different cardinalities. I also comment on (i) the invariance of the CH model to some transformations of the sequential game, and (ii) the independence of conditional beliefs about co-players’ level-types.
records.abstract_cn: 在最近的一篇论文中，Lin 和 Palfrey (2024) 提出了顺序博弈中的认知层次 (CH) 理论，并观察到该解决方案概念不是简化正态形式不变式。在本文中，我限定并解释了这一观察结果。我证明了 CH 模型是正态形式不变的，并且 CH 模型应用于简化正态形式所产生的差异仅取决于如何对级别 0 类型的随机化进行建模。事实上，虽然扩展形式的统一行为策略产生了规范形式的统一混合策略，但后者并不对应于简化规范形式的均匀随机化，因为不同的简化策略可能对应于具有不同基数的等价策略集。我还评论了 (i) CH 模型对顺序游戏的某些转换的不变性，以及 (ii) 关于共同玩家关卡类型的条件信念的独立性。

records.title_en: The effects of induced emotions on punishment and reward
records.title_cn: 诱发情绪对惩罚和奖励的影响
records.abstract_en: The ability to punish free-riders has been shown to sustain cooperation in social dilemma games. Those that engage in costly punishment are often those that are angry at observed contributions of their fellow group members. This paper abstracts from the effect of integral (i.e., related to the situation) emotions and explicitly studies the effect of incidental (i.e., unrelated to the situation) emotions. By inducing either positive or negative emotions we can causally investigate the effect of negative emotions on punishment or reward decisions in a one-shot public good game where personal and social interests are at odds. Our findings suggest that neither punishment nor reward per se are a function of induced (incidental) emotions. Induced emotions also do not have an effect on the probability to punish or reward. However, we find that conditionally on punishing, subjects that are induced to be in a negative mood punish group members significantly harsher than subjects who are induced to be in a positive mood. The handing out of rewards is not affected by induced moods.
records.abstract_cn: 惩罚搭便车者的能力已被证明可以维持社会困境游戏中的合作。那些进行代价高昂的惩罚的人往往是那些对观察到的其他小组成员的贡献感到愤怒的人。本文抽象了整体（即与情境相关）情绪的影响，并明确研究了偶然（即与情境无关）情绪的影响。通过诱发积极或消极情绪，我们可以在个人利益和社会利益不一致的 一 公益游戏中因果性地研究消极情绪对惩罚或奖励决策的影响。我们的研究结果表明，惩罚和奖励本身都不是诱发（偶然）情绪的函数。诱发的情绪也不影响惩罚或奖励的概率。然而，我们发现，在惩罚的条件下，被诱导处于消极情绪的受试者对小组成员的惩罚明显比被诱导处于积极情绪的受试者更严厉。奖励的发放不受诱发情绪的影响。

records.title_en: Efficient equilibrium in submodular global games of entry
records.title_cn: 子模全局进入博弈的有效均衡
records.abstract_en: We propose a global games approach to the standard two-stage entry game. The entry decisions in the first stage are strategic substitutes. The second-stage game of product market competition reflects a fundamental common value “market attractiveness” parameter, about which firms get private noisy signals. The main result establishes the selection of a unique equilibrium in the entry game, as noise vanishes, in cut-off strategies implying efficient entry. This provides a theoretical foundation for the equilibrium selection commonly used in entry models in the empirical literature. In addition, using supermodularity techniques, we provide novel conditions of independent interest on the primitives (demand and cost functions) of market competition to justify our assumptions for Bertrand and Cournot competition. These include results on the effects of entry and demand shifts and highlight the critical relevance of the property of log-supermodularity of demand.
records.abstract_cn: 我们针对标准 二 阶段入门游戏提出了一种全球游戏方法。 第一 阶段的进入决策是战略替代。产品市场竞争的 第二 阶段博弈反映了一个基本的共同价值“市场吸引力”参数，企业获得关于该参数的私人噪声信号。主要结果在进入游戏中建立了独特均衡的选择，随着噪声消失，在意味着有效进入的截止策略中。这为实证文献中进入模型中常用的均衡选择提供了理论基础。此外，使用超模块化技术，我们提供了对市场竞争原语（需求和成本函数）独立感兴趣的新颖条件，以证明我们对伯特兰和古诺竞争的假设是正确的。这些包括关于进入和需求变化影响的结果，并强调需求的对数超模块化属性的关键相关性。

records.title_en: Competitive limit of competing auctions
records.title_cn: 竞争拍卖的竞争限制
records.abstract_en: We study the link between strategic equilibria of competing auctions and the “competitive distribution of auctions” (Peters, 1997). With minimal restrictions on each seller’s possible costs and feasible reserve prices, we show that as the number of players increases to infinity while fixing a positive buyer-to-seller ratio, symmetric perfect Bayesian equilibria of finite markets converge to the competitive equilibrium of the large market.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究竞争性拍卖的战略均衡与“拍卖的竞争性分配”之间的联系（Peters，1997）。在对每个卖方的可能成本和可行底价的限制最小化的情况下，我们表明，随着参与者数量增加到无穷大，同时固定正的买卖双方比率，有限市场的对称完美贝叶斯均衡收敛到大市场的竞争均衡。

records.title_en: A simultaneous analysis of turnout and voting under proportional representation: Theory and experiments
records.title_cn: 比例代表制下投票率和投票的同步分析：理论与实验
records.abstract_en: In a system of proportional representation, we study the interaction between a voter’s turnout decision and her party choice, and how these relate to party polarization. Models of strategic interaction with instrumental voting, such as Nash and Quantal Response, predict such interaction effects, while Naive Voting models do not. In particular, the instrumental voting models predict (i) a Polarization Effect: reduced strategic party choice when voting is voluntary makes voters more likely to vote for extreme parties (conditional on voting at all); (ii) an Extremist Effect: voters supporting extreme parties are most likely to vote; (iii) a Turnout Effect: party polarization increases voter turnout. We provide data from a laboratory experiment that provide some support for these theoretical predictions. In addition, we provide supporting empirical evidence from real-world elections. Thus, the interaction between turnout and strategic voting that has been neglected in most of the previous literature is shown to be important, as predicted by models of instrumental voting.
records.abstract_cn: 在比例代表制中，我们研究选民的投票率决定和政党选择之间的相互作用，以及它们与政党两极分化的关系。与工具性投票的策略交互模型（例如纳什和量子响应）可以预测这种交互效应，而朴素投票模型则不能。特别是，工具性投票模型预测（i）极化效应：自愿投票时战略政党选择的减少使得选民更有可能投票给极端政党（完全以投票为条件）； (ii) 极端主义效应：支持极端政党的选民最有可能投票； (iii) 投票率效应：政党两极分化增加选民投票率。我们提供了实验室实验的数据，为这些理论预测提供了一些支持。此外，我们还提供来自现实世界选举的支持性经验证据。因此，正如工具投票模型所预测的那样，先前大多数文献中忽视的投票率和策略投票之间的相互作用被证明是重要的。

records.title_en: Competing for influence in networks through strategic targeting
records.title_cn: 通过战略定位争夺网络影响力
records.abstract_en: We experimentally investigate targeting decisions in a setting where a human player competes for influence in a network against a computerized opponent with opposing views, whose targeting choice is revealed before the player acts. By varying network structure, opponent influence, and nodes opinion heterogeneity, we find that players typically adopt best-response strategies based on relative influence. However, they sometimes deviate – for example, by erroneously targeting central nodes or by avoiding the opponent’s target. Targeting is also affected by affinity and opposition biases, the strength of which depends on the initial opinion distribution. Targeting the center, avoiding the competitor’s target, or selecting nodes based on their initial opinions when these are not best responses generates significant efficiency losses.
records.abstract_cn: 我们实验性地研究了人类玩家在网络中与持相反观点的计算机化对手竞争影响力的环境中的目标决策，其目标选择在玩家行动之前就已揭示。通过改变网络结构、对手影响力和节点意见异质性，我们发现参与者通常会根据相对影响力采取最佳响应策略。然而，它们有时会出现偏差——例如，错误地瞄准中心节点或避开对手的目标。目标定位还受到亲和力和反对偏见的影响，其强度取决于最初的意见分布。当这些不是最佳响应时，瞄准中心、避开竞争对手的目标或根据他们的初步意见选择节点会产生显着的效率损失。

records.title_en: Potentials in social environments
records.title_cn: 社会环境中的潜力
records.abstract_en: We develop and extend notions of potentials for normal-form games (Monderer and Shapley, 1996) to present a unified approach for the general class of social environments. The different potentials and corresponding social environments can be ordered in terms of their permissiveness. We classify different methods to construct potentials and we characterize potentials for matching problems, vote trading, multilateral trade, TU games, and various pillage games.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发并扩展了正常形式游戏（Monderer 和 Shapley、1996）的潜力概念，为一般的社交环境提供了一种统一的方法。不同的潜力和相应的社会环境可以根据其允许程度进行排序。我们对构建势的不同方法进行了分类，并描述了匹配问题、投票交易、多边贸易、TU 博弈和各种掠夺博弈的势。

records.title_en: Designing Heaven’s will: The job assignment in the Chinese imperial civil service
records.title_cn: 设计天意：中国皇家文官的工作分配
records.abstract_en: We study the evolution of entry-level civil service job assignment in imperial China from the tenth to the early twentieth century. The procedures were sequential, irrevocable, and publicly verifiable, relying increasingly on lots-drawing and operating under constraints that limited which posts candidates could fill and where they could be posted. Using a unified matching framework, we compare procedures by their ability to maximize the number of filled posts and to assign higher-ranked jobs to higher-degree candidates. We show that reforms intended to improve these outcomes can instead reverse them once constraints interact, a failure driven by greedy sequential matching. Building on the structure of the final historical procedure, we describe minimal extensions of public lots-drawing mechanisms that guarantee maximum matchings under compatibility constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了从 第十 到二十世纪初中国帝制时期初级公务员工作分配的演变。这些程序是连续的、不可撤销的、可公开验证的，越来越依赖抽签，并且在限制候选人可以填补的职位和他们可以被派往的地方的限制下运作。使用统一的匹配框架，我们根据最大化填补职位数量并将较高职位分配给较高学历候选人的能力来比较程序。我们表明，一旦约束相互作用，旨在改善这些结果的改革可能会逆转它们，这是由贪婪顺序匹配导致的失败。基于最终历史程序的结构，我们描述了公共抽签机制的最小扩展，以保证兼容性约束下的最大匹配。

records.title_en: Lucky but confident –The effect of confidence on meritocratic beliefs and preferences for redistribution
records.title_cn: 幸运但自信——自信对功绩主义信念及再分配偏好的影响
records.abstract_en: How does confidence in combination with success affect meritocratic beliefs and preferences for redistribution? In a large-scale real-effort competition (n = 1365), we manipulate both confidence and the outcome of the competition to provide causal evidence. First, we show that increased confidence causes successful participants to perceive outcomes as more meritocratic, while unsuccessful participants perceive outcomes as more determined by luck. Thus, increased confidence polarizes meritocratic beliefs between successful and unsuccessful individuals. Second, we find no statistically significant effect of confidence on preferences for redistribution. However, we do find that winning the competition significantly reduces the willingness to redistribute, regardless of confidence treatment. Our findings suggest that disagreements about the causes of inequality are most likely among individuals who anticipate success in a meritocratic system, and that success and failure can have large polarizing effects on preferences for redistribution.
records.abstract_cn: 自信与成功的结合如何影响功绩主义信念及再分配偏好？在一项大规模实际努力竞赛中（样本量 = 1365），我们操控了自信和竞赛结果，以提供因果证据。第一，我们发现自信的提升使成功参与者更倾向于将结果视为功绩决定，而失败参与者则更倾向于认为结果由运气决定。因此，自信的提升加剧了成功与失败个体之间的功绩主义信念分化。第二，我们未发现自信对再分配偏好有统计显著影响。然而，我们发现无论自信处理如何，赢得竞赛显著降低了再分配意愿。我们的研究结果表明，关于不平等成因的分歧最可能出现在预期在功绩体系中成功的个体之间，且成功与失败对再分配偏好具有显著的极化效应。

records.title_en: When information and communication are both costly
records.title_cn: 当信息和沟通均有成本时
records.abstract_en: I consider environments where an upwardly-biased expert faces both costs of acquiring information and of “transmitting inaccurate information relative to the realized state” (forecasting error) when advising a decision-maker. While existing models study these costs separately, I show that considering them jointly can substantially alter standard results. Introducing costly information acquisition overturns the partial-communication and language-inflation predictions of models with bounded messages and costly communication: equilibrium communication features truth-telling and full transmission of the acquired information. At the same time, communication costs can reverse the structure of optimal information acquisition, shifting from partitions with decreasing interval lengths to partitions with increasing interval lengths when misreporting is sufficiently more costly than acquisition. Finally, information acquisition costs generate an acquisition–transmission dilemma: the expert never acquires information that cannot be credibly communicated, implying that perfect information acquisition is impossible.
records.abstract_cn: 我考虑了一个环境，其中一个存在向上偏差的专家在向决策者提供建议时，既面临获取信息的成本，也面临“相对于实现状态传递不准确信息的成本”（预测误差）。现有模型通常分别研究这两种成本，而我展示了将它们联合考虑会显著改变标准结果。引入有成本的信息获取推翻了带有有限信息和有成本沟通模型中的部分沟通和语言膨胀预测：均衡沟通表现为真实陈述和所获信息的完全传递。与此同时，当错误报告的成本远高于获取成本时，沟通成本可以逆转最优信息获取的结构，使得区间长度由递减分割转变为递增分割。最后，信息获取成本产生了获取-传递困境：专家永远不会获取无法可信传递的信息，这意味着完美信息获取是不可能的。

records.title_en: On the existence of a strong Nash equilibrium under the efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance mechanism
records.title_cn: 关于效率调整延迟接受机制下强纳什均衡的存在性
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a preference revelation game induced by the Efficiency-Adjusted Deferred Acceptance (EDA) mechanism in a priority-based allocation problem. The main findings are: (i) we show the existence of a strong Nash equilibrium under EDA through a simple algorithm; (ii) the equilibrium outcome from the algorithm coincides with the outcome of the Top Trading Cycles mechanism; and (iii) the strategy profile found by the algorithm is also a strictly strong Nash equilibrium in the game induced by the Deferred Acceptance mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了优先级分配问题中由效率调整延迟接受（EDA）机制引发的偏好揭示博弈。主要发现包括：(i) 我们通过一个简单算法证明了EDA机制下强纳什均衡的存在性；(ii) 该算法得到的均衡结果与顶级交易环机制的结果一致；(iii) 该算法找到的策略组合在由延迟接受机制引发的博弈中也是严格强纳什均衡。

records.title_en: Substitutes for nonunitary many-to-many matching with contracts
records.title_cn: 非单元多对多匹配合同的替代性
records.abstract_en: We consider many-to-many matching with contracts where each agent can sign multiple contracts with the same agent. In other words, the unitarity condition is not assumed in this model. We offer a weaker substitutability condition called substitutability across doctors, which is a generalization of unilateral substitutability. We show that if every hospital’s choice function satisfies substitutability across doctors and every doctor’s choice function is responsive, then a stable outcome exists. We establish this result by generalizing the cumulative offer process. Moreover, we propose an even weaker substitutability condition that incorporates observability of doctors’ contract offers during the algorithm. The same algorithm guarantees the existence of a stable outcome even when substitutability across doctors is replaced with the weaker condition. We additionally present a specific class of choice functions satisfying the weaker condition that can be applied to a temporary staffing market, particularly in which temp agencies may assign multiple temporary workers to each client.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑多对多匹配合同模型，其中每个代理可以与同一代理签订多个合同。换言之，该模型不假设单元性条件。我们提出了一种较弱的替代性条件，称为跨医生替代性，这是单边替代性的推广。我们证明，如果每个医院的选择函数满足跨医生替代性且每个医生的选择函数是响应性的，则存在稳定结果。我们通过推广累积报价过程来建立该结果。此外，我们提出了一种更弱的替代性条件，该条件结合了算法过程中医生合同报价的可观测性。即使将跨医生替代性替换为该更弱条件，同一算法仍保证稳定结果的存在。我们还展示了一类满足该更弱条件的特定选择函数，可应用于临时用工市场，特别是临时中介机构可能向每个客户分配多个临时工的情形。

records.title_en: Two-player binary global games without dominance solvable states
records.title_cn: 无优势可解状态下的二-玩家二元全球博弈
records.abstract_en: We extend global games à la Carlsson and van Damme (1993) to environments where the risk-dominant equilibrium is selected even if there is no dominance solvable game in the underlying class of games. Strict dominance can emerge in the global game from strategic uncertainty due to discrete payoff changes in underlying games, and we provide sufficient conditions on payoff changes that warrant iterated dominance of the risk-dominant equilibrium. Thus, strategic uncertainty creates strictly dominant actions as well as fostering iterated dominance, in contrast to global games hitherto where strategic uncertainty does only the latter. Discrete payoff changes tend to arise, in particular, in situations where a public good can be provided with varying degrees of coordination depending on the state, so that coordinating actions can be strategic substitutes and free-riding incentives are present. We illustrate our findings in a stylized public good provision model.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将Carlsson和van Damme (1993) 的全球博弈扩展到即使在基础博弈类别中不存在优势可解博弈时也能选择风险优势均衡的环境中。由于基础博弈中离散的收益变化，战略不确定性可能在全球博弈中产生严格优势，且我们提供了关于收益变化的充分条件，以保证风险优势均衡的迭代优势。因此，战略不确定性不仅创造了严格优势行为，还促进了迭代优势，这与迄今为止的全球博弈中战略不确定性仅促进后者的情况形成对比。离散收益变化尤其倾向于出现在公共物品可根据状态以不同协调程度提供的情形中，此时协调行为可能是战略替代品且存在搭便车激励。我们在一个程式化的公共物品提供模型中说明了我们的发现。

records.title_en: Persuasion of interacting receivers
records.title_cn: 相互作用接收者的劝说
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how to persuade multiple interacting receivers under arbitrary equilibrium selection and when receivers’ preferences may exhibit psychological traits. Our main result characterizes the conditions under which the sender can categorize information using partitions and then disclose partition-related information without altering the equilibrium outcome. This finding broadens the traditional direct approach based on the revelation principle, which categorizes messages solely by equilibrium actions. Consequently, our results support a generalized direct approach, which we apply to study information disclosure in fostering fairness within groups where members may demonstrate altruistic behaviors.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在任意均衡选择下以及接收者偏好可能表现出心理特征时，如何劝说多个相互作用的接收者。我们的主要结果刻画了发送者在何种条件下可以使用划分对信息进行分类，然后披露与划分相关的信息而不改变均衡结果。该发现拓展了基于启示原理的传统直接方法，后者仅通过均衡行为对信息进行分类。因此，我们的结果支持一种广义的直接方法，并将其应用于研究在成员可能表现出利他行为的群体中促进公平的信息披露。

records.title_en: The evolution of strategies in repeated 2 × 2 anti-coordination games
records.title_cn: 重复2×2反协调博弈中策略的演化
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the evolution of strategies in repeated 2 x 2 anti-coordination games. Turn-taking is advantageous against strategies that consistently choose the same stage-game action, provided the discount factor is sufficiently high or the payoff asymmetry in coordination is sufficiently low. However, it becomes vulnerable when the set of strategies allowed to invade is expanded. Nonetheless, if the matching process exhibits a high degree of assortativity, turn-taking regains robustness as long as it promotes efficiency.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了重复2×2反协调博弈中策略的演化。轮流行动在面对始终选择相同阶段博弈行动的策略时具有优势，前提是折现因子足够高或协调中的收益不对称性足够低。然而，当允许入侵的策略集合扩大时，轮流行动变得脆弱。尽管如此，如果匹配过程表现出高度的同类相配性，只要轮流行动促进效率，它就能重新获得稳健性。

records.title_en: Authority measure for opinion dynamics
records.title_cn: 舆论动态中的权威度量
records.abstract_en: We propose a formal framework for measuring the authority of individuals in opinion dynamics. Our framework is based on an axiomatic foundation in the tradition of coalitional game theory. We show that the unique solution concept satisfying our axioms is a generalization of the “authority distribution” notion of Hu and Shapley. Our approach is based on the dynamics of opinion exchange rather than on network topology. However, for any fixed opinion dynamics, our authority concept associates a network centrality measure with any given network topology. Earlier as well as new network centrality measures are obtained in this way.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个用于衡量舆论动态中个体权威性的形式化框架。该框架基于联盟博弈理论传统中的公理基础。我们证明，满足这些公理的唯一解概念是胡和沙普利“权威分布”概念的推广。我们的方法基于舆论交换的动态过程，而非网络拓扑结构。然而，对于任何固定的舆论动态，我们的权威概念都能将任意给定的网络拓扑关联到一个网络中心性度量。通过这种方式，可以获得既有的以及新的网络中心性度量。

records.title_en: The effort-maximizing move order in tullock contests
records.title_cn: 图洛克竞赛中的努力最大化出手顺序
records.abstract_en: This paper examines effort-maximizing move orders in two-player Tullock contests across varying levels of contest accuracy and player asymmetries. Unlike prior work that favors strong-lead sequential formats in lottery contests, our analysis demonstrates that all three formats—strong-lead, weak-lead, and simultaneous—can be optimal in the general Tullock contests. Strong-lead contests are most effective in noisy environments, but lose their advantage as contest accuracy increases. Weak-lead contests may become optimal when the weaker player successfully preempts. Simultaneous-move contests tend to perform better as the players’ ability differences become less severe. Overall, the optimal contest design jointly depends on the contest accuracy levels and relative strengths of the contestants.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在不同竞赛准确度和参与者非对称性水平下，二玩家图洛克竞赛中的努力最大化出手顺序。与以往偏好强先手顺序格式的彩票竞赛研究不同，我们的分析表明，在一般图洛克竞赛中，所有三格式——强先手、弱先手和同时出手——均可能是最优的。强先手竞赛在噪声环境中最为有效，但随着竞赛准确度的提高，其优势减弱。弱先手竞赛在较弱玩家成功抢先时可能成为最优选择。随着玩家能力差异减小，同时出手竞赛表现趋于更优。总体而言，最优竞赛设计取决于竞赛准确度水平和参赛者相对实力的共同作用。

records.title_en: Strategic formation of production networks
records.title_cn: 生产网络的战略形成
records.abstract_en: We provide a strategic model of the formation of production networks that subsumes the standard general equilibrium approach. The objective of firms in our setting is to choose their supply relationships so as to maximize their profit at the general equilibrium that unfolds. We show that this objective is equivalent to the maximization by the firms of their eigenvector centrality in the production network. As is common in network formation games based on centrality, there are multiple Nash equilibria in our setting. We have investigated the characteristics and social efficiency of these equilibria in a stylized version of our model representing international trade networks. We show that the impact of network structure on social welfare is firstly determined by a trade-off between costs of increasing process complexity and positive spillovers on productivity induced by the diversification of the input mix. We further analyze a variant of our model that accounts for the risks of disruption of supply relationships. In this setting, we characterize how social welfare depends on the structure of the production network, the spatial distribution of risks, and the process of shock aggregation in supply chains. We finally show that simple trade policies characterized by sets of links that are either prevented or catalyzed can be a powerful equilibrium selection device.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个生产网络形成的战略模型，该模型涵盖了标准的一般均衡方法。在我们的设定中，企业的目标是选择其供应关系，以最大化其在所形成的一般均衡中的利润。我们证明了这一目标等同于企业最大化其在生产网络中的特征向量中心性。正如基于中心性的网络形成博弈中常见的那样，我们的设定中存在多个纳什均衡。我们在一个代表国际贸易网络的模型简化版本中，研究了这些均衡的特征及其社会效率。我们表明，网络结构对社会福利的影响首先取决于增加流程复杂性的成本与由投入组合多样化引起的生产率正向溢出之间的权衡。我们进一步分析了一个考虑供应关系中断风险的模型变体。在该设定中，我们刻画了社会福利如何依赖于生产网络结构、风险的空间分布以及供应链中冲击聚合的过程。最后，我们展示了通过阻止或促进特定链接的简单贸易政策，可以成为一种强有力的均衡选择机制。

records.title_en: A model of participatory persuasion
records.title_cn: 参与式说服模型
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces the concept of participatory persuasion in autocracies, where regimes use controlled communication to sustain their rule. In an overlapping-generations model of democratization, we show that the regime’s survival can be prolonged when citizens communicate within small circles compared to a setting in which communication is entirely absent. Paradoxically, limited freedom of speech enhances the regime’s persuasion by turning citizens into inadvertent agents of state propaganda. We further extend the analysis to settings with homophily or under state censorship.
records.abstract_cn: 本文引入了专制政体中参与式说服的概念，即政权通过受控的沟通维持其统治。在一个重叠世代的民主化模型中，我们展示了当公民在小圈子内交流时，相较于完全缺乏沟通的情形，政权的存续时间可以被延长。矛盾的是，有限的言论自由通过将公民转变为无意中的国家宣传代理人，增强了政权的说服力。我们进一步将分析扩展到具有同质性或处于国家审查环境下的情形。

records.title_en: Delay in social learning
records.title_cn: 社会学习中的延迟
records.abstract_en: We study a class of social learning games in which players choose whether and when to make an irreversible investment. We ask whether the option value of learning induces delay. Surprisingly, under natural and standard assumptions, delay does not arise in equilibrium. Although waiting even momentarily would yield informative observations, we show that this learning is payoff-irrelevant. As a result, players either invest immediately or not at all.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一类社会学习博弈，其中参与者选择是否以及何时进行不可逆投资。我们探讨了学习的期权价值是否会导致延迟。令人惊讶的是，在自然且标准的假设下，均衡中并不存在延迟。尽管即使短暂等待也会产生有信息的观察，但我们证明这种学习对收益无关紧要。因此，参与者要么立即投资，要么根本不投资。

records.title_en: Caps on bids in all-pay contests with identity-dependent externalities
records.title_cn: 具有身份依赖外部性的全额支付竞赛中的出价上限
records.abstract_en: This article examines, both theoretically and experimentally, the welfare implications of implementing symmetric bid caps in lobbying competitions. We model lobbying games as lottery contests with two radicals and one centrist, where all players strictly prefer to win. However, if they lose, radicals prefer to lose to a centrist rather than to the opposing radical. We establish the existence and uniqueness of equilibrium and find that, in the absence of a bid cap, radicals may bid aggressively enough to drive the centrist out of the competition, thereby preventing the social welfare-maximizing outcome. Consequently, implementing a bid cap enhances social welfare in two ways: it reduces aggregate expenditure and increases the likelihood of the centrist winning. Our experimental results qualitatively align with the theoretical predictions. However, we also identify and address notable behavioral patterns: in contrast to the vast experimental literature (Sheremeta, 2013) on contests, aggregate bids do not exceed theoretical predictions in all treatments.
records.abstract_cn: 本文从理论和实验两个角度考察了在游说竞争中实施对称出价上限的福利影响。我们将游说博弈建模为包含二名激进派和一名中间派的抽签竞赛，所有参与者均严格偏好获胜。然而，若失败，激进派更倾向于输给中间派而非对立激进派。我们证明了均衡的存在性和唯一性，发现若无出价上限，激进派可能出价过于激进，导致中间派被挤出竞争，从而阻碍社会福利最大化结果的实现。因此，实施出价上限通过二种方式提升社会福利：降低总支出并增加中间派获胜的可能性。我们的实验结果在定性上与理论预测一致，但也发现并解决了显著的行为模式：与大量竞赛实验文献（Sheremeta，2013）不同，所有处理中的总出价均未超过理论预测。

records.title_en: Transparency and information acquisition in college admissions
records.title_cn: 大学录取中的透明度与信息获取
records.abstract_en: We theoretically and experimentally study centralized college admissions in which colleges evaluate students under a ‘translucent’ admission system and students can learn each college’s suitability through costly information acquisition. In centralized matching via Gale and Shapley’s deferred acceptance algorithm, students decide whether to acquire information before submitting their rank-order lists. However, uncertainty about the final assignment lowers the expected gain from learning, thereby reducing social welfare, compared to a scenario without such uncertainty. Our experiments demonstrate that the welfare loss is greater with more opaque admission systems. The empirical social welfare obtained in our experimental treatments is consistently lower than the theoretical welfare, and we identify non-equilibrium learning as a main contributor.
records.abstract_cn: 我们从理论和实验两个角度研究了集中式大学录取，在该录取系统中，大学在“半透明”录取制度下评估学生，学生则通过付出成本的信息获取来了解各大学的适合度。在通过Gale和Shapley的延迟接受算法进行的集中匹配中，学生决定是否在提交排名列表前获取信息。然而，关于最终分配的不确定性降低了学习的预期收益，从而相比于无此类不确定性的情形降低了社会福利。我们的实验表明，录取制度越不透明，福利损失越大。实验处理中的经验社会福利始终低于理论福利，我们确定非均衡学习是主要原因之一。

records.title_en: Eliciting and distinguishing between weak and incomplete preferences: Theory, experiment and computation
records.title_cn: 引出并区分弱偏好与不完全偏好：理论、实验与计算
records.abstract_en: We propose an experimental design and data-analytic method for eliciting and distinguishing the strict-preference, indifference, and indecisiveness components of individual preferences in general choice environments. The design combines a forced-choice treatment with a free-choice treatment. In both treatments, subjects may select multiple alternatives from a menu. In the free-choice treatment, subjects may also avoid or delay choice at a small expected cost. To analyze such data, we extend a standard non-parametric goodness-of-fit criterion to accommodate multi-valued choices. We apply it to evaluate the consistency of subjects’ 50 decisions with utility maximization and two models of incomplete-preference maximization. Around 55% of subjects are well explained by one of these models, with 33% and 22% best explained by utility and incomplete-preference maximization, respectively. Revealed preferences typically feature non-trivial indifferences, and those that are incomplete often exhibit the predicted theoretical distinctions between indifference and indecisiveness, which are documented empirically for the first time.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种实验设计和数据分析方法，用于在一般选择环境中引出并区分个体偏好的严格偏好、无差异和犹豫成分。该设计结合了强制选择处理和自由选择处理。在两种处理中，受试者均可从菜单中选择多个备选项。在自由选择处理中，受试者还可以以较小的预期成本避免或延迟选择。为分析此类数据，我们扩展了标准的非参数拟合优度准则，以适应多值选择。我们将其应用于评估受试者的50决策与效用最大化及不完全偏好最大化的二模型的一致性。约55%的受试者被这些模型中的一良好解释，其中33%和22%分别由效用最大化和不完全偏好最大化最佳解释。揭示的偏好通常具有非平凡的无差异，而不完全偏好常表现出理论上预测的无差异与犹豫之间的区别，这些区别在第一时间段内得到了实证记录。

records.title_en: Information manipulation of wishful thinkers
records.title_cn: 愿望性思维者的信息操控
records.abstract_en: Digital platforms may manipulate customer reviews to impede other consumers from acquiring accurate information and to increase sales. In a rational inattention setting where consumers acquire information about product quality before making purchasing decisions, we show that the platform has incentives to restrict information acquisition in the presence of consumers with wishful thinking. These biased consumers are unaware of their bias and weigh any good news about the product quality more heavily than a Bayesian consumer. We identify the conditions under which the firm optimally constrains information acquisition, and characterize when competition can alleviate this type of exploitation. Our results extend to a broader class of non-Bayesian rules beyond wishful thinking.
records.abstract_cn: 数字平台可能操控客户评价，以阻碍其他消费者获取准确信息并增加销售额。在一个理性忽视的框架下，消费者在做出购买决策前获取关于产品质量的信息，我们证明在存在愿望性思维消费者的情况下，平台有激励限制信息获取。这些有偏消费者未意识到其偏见，并且对任何关于产品质量的好消息赋予比贝叶斯消费者更高的权重。我们确定了企业最优限制信息获取的条件，并刻画了竞争何时能够缓解此类剥削。我们的结果可推广至愿望性思维之外更广泛的非贝叶斯规则类别。

records.title_en: Cheap talk and lie detection
records.title_cn: 廉价言语与谎言检测
records.abstract_en: This study analyzes strategic interactions between cheap talk and lie detection, identifies the receiver-optimal equilibrium under costly lie detection, and evaluates its effectiveness. An informed sender seeks to persuade an uninformed receiver to choose higher actions, while the receiver aims to align the action as closely as possible with the true state. The sender issues a claim about the state, and the receiver then decides whether to incur a cost to inspect the claim’s truthfulness. We show that the receiver-optimal equilibrium partitions the state space into three intervals. Types in the upper interval make precise and truthful claims, which are mimicked by types in the lower interval and are subject to random inspection. Types in the middle interval make a vague claim that is never inspected. We further show that lie detection is more beneficial to the receiver than direct state verification, as it creates incentives for moderate and high types to communicate truthfully.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了廉价言语与谎言检测之间的战略互动，确定了在有成本的谎言检测下接收者最优均衡，并评估其有效性。一位知情的发送者试图说服一位不知情的接收者选择更高的行动，而接收者旨在使行动尽可能接近真实状态。发送者发布关于状态的声明，接收者随后决定是否支付成本以检查声明的真实性。我们表明，接收者最优均衡将状态空间划分为若干区间。上区间的类型做出精确且真实的声明，下区间的类型模仿上区间的声明并受到随机检查。中间区间的类型做出模糊声明，且从不被检查。我们进一步表明，谎言检测比直接状态验证对接收者更有利，因为它激励中等和高类型的发送者进行真实沟通。

records.title_en: Competition in persuasion in the attention economy
records.title_cn: 注意力经济中的说服竞争
records.abstract_en: Gentzkow and Kamenica (2016) show that competition among senders benefits receivers if and only if the information environment is Blackwell-connected. This paper shows that introducing receivers’ limited attention and heterogeneous beliefs can overturn this result. Even in a Blackwell-connected information environment, information revelation may be lower under duopoly than under monopoly. Indeed, limited attention may incentivize receivers to sort into the audiences of like-minded senders. In turn, this adverse sorting can make it optimal for senders to reveal less information.
records.abstract_cn: Gentzkow 和 Kamenica（2016）表明，只有在信息环境是 Blackwell 连通的情况下，发送者之间的竞争才会使接收者受益。本文表明，引入接收者的有限注意力和异质信念可能推翻这一结果。即使在 Blackwell 连通的信息环境下，双头垄断下的信息揭示也可能低于垄断下的水平。事实上，有限的注意力可能激励接收者分流到志同道合的发送者受众中。反过来，这种不利的分流可能使发送者选择揭示更少信息成为最优策略。

records.title_en: Ambiguity and technology adoption under index insurance: Experimental evidence
records.title_cn: 模糊性与指数保险下技术采纳：实验证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effect of ambiguity on technology adoption under index insurance. I conduct an artefactual field experiment with Ghanaian cocoa farmers. Experimental subjects had an option to invest in a package of fertilizer bundled with index insurance. The returns depended both on the subjects’ investment choices and on a stochastic weather realization. The key ingredient of the study was whether the exact probability of bad weather was known or not. This probability was ambiguous in the experimental treatments, and the degree of this ambiguity varied across treatments. A large negative effect on fertilizer investments was found in treatments with either small or large ambiguity. The effect of large ambiguity was also found to be significantly stronger, suggesting that technologies with which farmers are relatively more experienced are more likely to be adopted under index insurance schemes. I provide new evidence that ambiguity may be a significant factor limiting the effectiveness of index insurance in promoting agricultural innovation. The overall findings are complementary to related recent randomized controlled trials, since it is effectively impossible to precisely calibrate and vary the level of ambiguity using the latter methodology.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了模糊性对指数保险下技术采纳的影响。作者在加纳可可农户中进行了一项人为场景实验。实验对象有选择投资一揽子含指数保险的化肥的选项。收益既取决于受试者的投资选择，也取决于随机天气实现。研究的关键在于是否知道恶劣天气的确切概率。该概率在实验处理组中具有模糊性，且模糊程度在不同处理组中存在差异。在模糊性较小或较大的处理组中，化肥投资受到显著的负面影响。研究还发现，模糊性较大的影响更为显著，暗示农户相对更有经验的技术在指数保险方案下更可能被采纳。作者提供了新的证据表明，模糊性可能是限制指数保险在促进农业创新方面有效性的重要因素。总体发现与相关的近期随机对照试验互为补充，因为后者在精确校准和变化模糊水平方面实际上几乎不可能实现。

records.title_en: Cost and affordability of recommended diets in Rwanda using [near] real-time market data
records.title_cn: 卢旺达基于[近]实时市场数据的推荐膳食成本与可负担性
records.abstract_en: Countries are increasingly benchmarking food assistance and labour laws on the cost of nationally recommended diets. Benchmarking is made against national annual estimates, which fail to account for sub-national and intra-annual variation in cost, blunting the impact of policies. Using monthly market price data collected by the Government of Rwanda (April 2019-March 2024), we estimate the cost of the country’s proposed food-based dietary guidelines, using a standardised diet costing methodology. We found rural areas experienced greater inflation in diet cost over the study period than urban areas (41% vs 28%), yet the recommended diet was 12.7% higher in urban locations. Diet costs were approximately 6% lower in districts with international border crossings to Tanzania, but 7% more in those with borders with the Democratic Republic of Congo. Fruits and vegetables (110% and 71%) and starchy staples (86% and 83%) contributed most to cost increases in rural and urban locations respectively. Seasonal diet cost fluctuations were also evident with a seasonal amplitude of 5.6% and 6.9% in rural and urban locations, synchronised to Rwanda’s agricultural calendar. 70% of employed Rwandans would find the recommended diet unaffordable, if spending 52% of wages on food. Diet costs varied 4.2-fold across all districts throughout the study period, meaning that uniform national policies to address costs and affordability would be systematically inadequate in high-cost settings and wasteful in low-cost ones. That such spatial–temporal variation exists in a small, relatively market integrated country like Rwanda suggests variation would be at least equally consequential in other low and lower-middle-income countries. High-frequency and sub-national monitoring of prices, diet costs, and affordability provides essential intelligence for policymakers to enable spatially and seasonally targeted interventions, improving both the adequacy and efficiency of food policy.
records.abstract_cn: 各国日益将国家推荐膳食的成本作为食品援助和劳动法律的基准。基准通常以国家年度估算为依据，未能考虑子国家和年度内的成本变异，削弱了政策的影响。利用卢旺达政府收集的每月市场价格数据（四月 2019-三月 2024），我们采用标准化的膳食成本核算方法，估算了该国拟议的以食物为基础的膳食指南的成本。研究发现，农村地区在研究期间的膳食成本通胀高于城市地区（41% 对比 28%），但在城市地区推荐膳食的成本更高（12.7%）。在与坦桑尼亚有国际边境的地区，膳食成本大约比其他地区低（6%），而与刚果民主共和国接壤的地区则更高（7%）。水果和蔬菜（110% 和 71%）以及淀粉类主食（86% 和 83%）对农村和城市地区成本的增加贡献最大。季节性膳食成本波动也很明显，农村和城市地区的季节性振幅分别为 5.6% 和 6.9%，与卢旺达的农业季节同步。若卢旺达的在职人员将其工资的 70% 用于食品，则 52% 的人将发现推荐膳食难以负担。研究期间，膳食成本在所有地区的变动范围达 4.2 倍，表明统一的国家政策在高成本地区可能系统性不足，而在低成本地区则可能造成资源浪费。如此空间-时间变异在像卢旺达这样的小型、市场相对一体化的国家中存在，意味着在其他低收入和中低收入国家中，这种变异至少同样具有重要意义。高频率和子国家层面的价格、膳食成本及可负担性监测，为政策制定者提供了关键情报，以实现空间和季节性针对性干预，从而改善食品政策的充足性和效率。

records.title_en: Seasonality of employment and food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa
records.title_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区就业季节性与粮食安全
records.abstract_en: Many rural households in sub-Saharan Africa rely on rainfed agriculture, meaning that harvests and incomes from farming are highly seasonal. This leads to recurring periods of food insecurity, commonly referred to as lean seasons. Off-farm employment may help mitigate seasonal food insecurity, but evidence on whether it actually does remains scarce. Using panel data from high-frequency phone surveys in Burkina Faso, Malawi, and Uganda, covering the period from 2020–2024, we examine seasonal labor reallocation and implications for food security throughout the year. We find that seasonal labor shifts from farming to off-farm sectors are associated with reduced seasonal food insecurity in most contexts, especially for off-farm wage employment. We also find that in regions where multiple cropping seasons are possible, work in farming is more strongly associated with food security than off-farm wage or self-employment. However, seasonal shifts from farming to other income-generating activities are not very large at the aggregate level, possibly due to lack of rural labor opportunities. These findings highlight that — depending on the context — improvements of opportunities for farming and off-farm employment are important to ensure year-round food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa.
records.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲的许多农村家庭依赖雨养农业，这意味着农作物收获和农业收入具有高度的季节性。这导致粮食安全问题周期性出现，通常被称为粮食短缺季节。非农就业可能有助于缓解季节性粮食不安全问题，但关于其是否确实有效的证据仍然不足。利用布基纳法索、马拉维和乌干达2020-2024年期间的高频电话调查面板数据，我们研究了全年劳动力季节性再分配及其对粮食安全的影响。我们发现，从农业向非农部门的季节性劳动力转移在大多数情况下与季节性粮食不安全的减少相关，尤其是非农工资就业。我们还发现，在可能实现多季种植的地区，农业工作与粮食安全的关联性比非农工资或自雇就业更强。然而，从农业向其他收入生成活动的季节性转移在总体上并不显著，可能是由于农村劳动力机会的缺乏。这些发现表明，根据具体情况，改善农业和非农就业机会对于确保撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区全年的粮食安全至关重要。

records.title_en: A critical review of EU agri-food policy impacts
records.title_cn: 对欧盟农业食品政策影响的批判性回顾
records.abstract_en: The European Union’s agri-food policies aim to balance productivity with environmental, social, and economic sustainability. However, their overall effectiveness remains debated due to fragmented evidence and inconsistent implementation. This study critically reviews the literature on the cumulative impacts of EU policies governing primary agricultural production, focusing on six sectors: the Common Agricultural Policy, genetically modified organisms, pesticide, fertilizers, fisheries, and animal health and welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 欧洲联盟的农业食品政策旨在平衡生产力与环境、社会和经济的可持续性。然而，由于证据碎片化和执行不一致，其整体有效性仍存在争议。本研究对关于欧盟管理初级农业生产的政策累积影响的文献进行了批判性回顾，重点关注农业、转基因生物、农药、化肥、渔业以及动物健康与福利等六个领域。

records.title_en: Agenda-setting in local food environment policy: A comparative Multiple Streams Analysis of the City Deal network in the Netherlands
records.title_cn: 地方食品环境政策中的议程设置：荷兰城市合作网络的多重流分析比较
records.abstract_en: Little is known about the processes through which local food environment policies gain a place on municipal policy agendas. This study examines why some municipalities within the Dutch City Deal: Healthy and Sustainable Food Environment succeed in placing food strategies and food environmental zoning policies on the agenda.
records.abstract_cn: 关于地方食品环境政策如何进入市政政策议程的过程知之甚少。本研究探讨为何荷兰城市合作：健康与可持续食品环境中的某些市政当局能够成功将食品策略和食品环境分区政策列入议程。

records.title_en: Extreme heat and markets: Theoretical and empirical evidence from Nigeria
records.title_cn: 极端高温与市场：尼日利亚的理论与实证证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate how exposure to extreme temperature affects smallholder commercialization. We examine a range of outcomes that indicate the degree of commercialization, including market participation, sales quantity, commercialization index, and sales revenue, which serves as an indicator of monetary benefit. Recognizing the non-separability between production and commercialization, we also examine how extreme temperature directly affects agricultural production. To address these questions, we develop a simple and straightforward theoretical framework that links temperature events to production and market dynamics. From this framework, we derive a set of hypotheses which we proceed to test empirically. Our empirical strategy leverages a comprehensive three-wave panel dataset, which we integrate with earth observation data on temperature extremes. We find that extreme temperatures lead to production losses. We also observe significant declines in market participation among smallholder farmers which could be explained by production shortfalls. This reduction is evident at both the extensive margin (likelihood of participating in markets) and the intensive margin (sales quantity). Furthermore, we observe that when farmers face extreme temperatures, the proportion of harvested crops they sell and the resulting revenue from these also decrease. Causal mediation analysis further confirms that production losses due to extreme temperatures explains the reduction in market outcomes. Overall, these findings highlight the broader economic burden that extreme weather events continue to impose on smallholder households.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究极端温度暴露如何影响小农户的商品化程度。我们考察一系列反映商品化程度的结果指标，包括市场参与、销售数量、商品化指数和销售收入，后者作为货币收益的指标。鉴于生产与商品化之间的非可分离性，我们还分析极端温度如何直接影响农业生产。为此，我们建立了一个简洁直观的理论框架，将温度事件与生产和市场动态联系起来。基于此框架，我们提出一系列假设，并进行实证检验。我们的实证策略利用一份全面的三-波段面板数据集，并结合关于温度极端事件的遥感数据。研究发现，极端温度导致生产损失。我们还观察到小农户的市场参与显著下降，这可能由生产短缺引起。这一减少在市场参与的广度（参与市场的可能性）和深度（销售数量）两个方面均有体现。此外，当农户面临极端温度时，他们出售的收获作物比例及由此产生的收入也会减少。因果中介分析进一步确认，极端温度引起的生产损失解释了市场结果的下降。总体而言，这些发现凸显了极端天气事件对小农户家庭持续带来的更广泛的经济负担。

records.title_en: Consumer preferences for sustainability labels: A comparative analysis of the green-score and other established labels
records.title_cn: 消费者对可持续性标签的偏好：绿色评分与其他既有标签的比较分析
records.abstract_en: The Green-Score label aims to complement established certifications by providing a standardized and easily interpretable assessment of products’ environmental performance. This study examines (i) the relative influence of Green-Score, organic, and Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) certifications on consumers’ willingness to pay (WTP); (ii) how label effectiveness varies across food categories; and (iii) the impact of a salience nudge on consumer choices. A Discrete Choice Experiment was conducted with a nationally representative sample of 1,102 Italian consumers, using a between-subjects design to evaluate the nudge. Results show that PDO labels, leveraging strong institutional credibility and symbolic value, consistently generate the highest marginal WTP (€7.61), especially for culturally and traditionally significant products. Green-Score A+ labels, valued for their diagnosticity and cross-product comparability, achieve an average marginal WTP of €6.25, slightly above organic certification (€4.59), with variation across product categories and treatment conditions. The salience nudge enhances the perceived value of Green-Score, particularly in contexts where environmental performance is salient, and can reduce the marginal contribution of overlapping labels such as organic certification. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of sustainability labels depends on both the balance between credibility and diagnosticity and the product-specific context, offering actionable insights for policymakers and stakeholders seeking to design targeted and effective environmental labelling strategies in food markets.
records.abstract_cn: 绿色评分标签旨在通过提供产品环境绩效的标准化和易于理解的评估来补充既有认证。本研究考察了（i）绿色评分、有机和原产地保护（PDO）认证对消费者支付意愿（WTP）的相对影响；（ii）标签效果如何因食品类别而异；（iii）显著性提示对消费者选择的影响。研究采用离散选择实验，以1,102名具有全国代表性的意大利消费者为样本，使用被试间设计评估提示效果。结果表明，PDO标签凭借其强大的机构信誉和象征价值，始终产生最高的边际支付意愿（7.61欧元），尤其是对文化和传统意义重大的产品。绿色评分A+标签因其诊断性和跨产品可比性，实现了6.25欧元的平均边际支付意愿，略高于有机认证（4.59欧元），且因产品类别和处理条件而异。显著性提示增强了绿色评分的感知价值，特别是在环境绩效显著的情境中，并可降低有机认证等重叠标签的边际贡献。这些发现表明，可持续性标签的有效性取决于信誉与诊断性之间的平衡以及产品特定情境，为政策制定者和利益相关者提供了可操作的洞察，以设计针对性和有效的食品市场环境标签策略。

records.title_en: UK Food standards agency proposals for re-structuring how it regulates food-borne risks: an analysis and critique
records.title_cn: 英国食品标准局关于重组其食品安全风险监管方式的提案：分析与批评
records.abstract_en: Official food policy-makers are expected both to ensure that they have a well-functioning system of food supply, processing, distribution and consumption while also ensuring that their citizens are protected from unsafe and unhealthy foods. It is evident that the implications of those two responsibilities can and sometimes do conflict; which historically has prompted the question: should those two policy responsibilities be institutionally co-located, or institutionally separated? The UK’s Food Standards Agency (FSA) was created in response to the policy failures revealed by the Mad Cow Disease saga. Previously one UK ministry had been responsible for both agendas, but the tension between them had been so severe that they contributed to turning the saga into a deep crisis. Responsibility for ensuring UK food safety was subsequently separated from the food industries’ sponsoring ministry, and transferred to the FSA. A recent set of proposals from the FSA recommends that the agency should expand its responsibilities by also endeavouring to promote the commercial interests of the food industries. Implementing the proposals risks undermining public confidence in the FSA and the safety of the UK’s food supply. The significance of the proposals goes beyond the UK as it illustrates a pivotal and ubiquitous axis of contestation in food policy-making, it illustrates ways in which food policy governance can be malleable rather than rigid, and explains how a combination of forgetfulness and economic re-prioritisation risks undermining food safety and public trust in policy-making.
records.abstract_cn: 官方食品政策制定者既要确保食品供应、加工、分销和消费体系的正常运作，又要保障公民免受不安全和不健康食品的危害。显而易见，这些责任的影响可能会发生冲突；这在历史上引发了一个问题：这些政策责任应当在制度上合并还是分离？英国食品标准局（FSA）成立的背景是应对疯牛病事件暴露的政策失误。此前，英国的相关部门同时负责这两个方面，但二者之间的紧张关系极为严重，导致事件演变成一场深刻的危机。确保英国食品安全的责任随后从食品行业的主管部门中剥离出来，转交给FSA。FSA近期提出的一系列建议建议该机构应扩大职责，兼顾促进食品行业的商业利益。实施这些建议可能会削弱公众对FSA及英国食品安全的信心。这些提案的意义超越英国，展示了食品政策制定中的一个关键且普遍存在的争论轴心，揭示了食品政策治理可以具有弹性而非刚性，以及说明了遗忘与经济再优先排序的结合如何可能削弱食品安全和公众对政策的信任。

records.title_en: The impact of post-harvest training interventions on adoption and production behavior: evidence from black pepper farmers in Sri Lanka
records.title_cn: 收获后培训干预对采纳和生产行为的影响：来自斯里兰卡黑胡椒农户的证据
records.abstract_en: As agricultural development increasingly targets high-value crops and markets, food quality and safety have become critical. However, smallholder farmers often face barriers to adopting quality-enhancing practices in the post-production stage because of their limited access to reliable information. Most research on information provision emphasises the need to reduce quantity losses in staple crops, leaving a research gap with respect to quality improvements in high-value crops such as black pepper. This study addresses this gap by evaluating the impact of government training and farmer-to-farmer experience sharing on the adoption of post-harvest quality improvement practices and production behaviour. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 660 black pepper farmers in the Matale District of Sri Lanka. We found that government training significantly improves the adoption of key post-harvest practices such as threshing, fresh berry grading, dry berry grading, and blanching and leads to a shift in production from low quality to high quality. Our findings highlight the importance of structured expertise-led training to improve the quality of high-value crops.
records.abstract_cn: 随着农业发展日益聚焦于高价值作物和市场，食品质量与安全变得至关重要。然而，小农户在采后阶段采用提升质量的实践中常面临信息获取有限的障碍。大部分关于信息提供的研究强调减少主粮作物的产量损失，忽视了高价值作物如黑胡椒的质量改善研究空白。本研究通过评估政府培训和农户间经验分享对采后质量改善实践采纳和生产行为的影响，填补了这一空白。我们在斯里兰卡马塔勒区对660黑胡椒农户进行了随机对照试验。研究发现，政府培训显著促进了打谷、鲜果等级划分、干果等级划分以及漂白等关键采后实践的采纳，并促使生产从低质量向高质量转变。我们的研究结果强调了结构化、由专业人员主导的培训在提升高价值作物质量方面的重要作用。

records.title_en: Regulatory heterogeneity, trade mediation and nutrient intake: The case of Trans fat
records.title_cn: 监管异质性、贸易中介作用与营养摄入：反式脂肪的案例
records.abstract_en: National nutrition regulations can shape diets in two distinct ways: directly, through domestic policy mechanisms, and indirectly, by mediating trade flows. This study assesses how trans fat (TF) intake is affected by both pathways. When countries act alone – by banning or limiting TF – their rules often differ in timing, stringency, and enforcement. The resulting regulatory heterogeneity can create loopholes that allow unhealthy products to move across borders. This study estimates the causal effects of TF regulations on its intake nationally by constructing a food-item-level panel dataset for 161 countries (2010–2022, validated with established benchmarks), and applying a staggered difference-in-differences approach combined with mediation analysis. The findings show that strict, enforceable regulations, such as those in the United States and European Union, significantly reduce TF intake and imports, acting as effective filters against TF-rich foods. In contrast, countries with weaker regulations experience rising TF imports and, eventually, increased intake, effectively placing them at risk of becoming “dietary risk havens.” Even modest rules work better when backed by strong monitoring. These results are robust to alternative specifications such as controlling for importer-specific foreign regulatory exposure. The causal evidence demonstrates that unilateral action delivers meaningful health gains, but fragmented regulatory approaches create opportunities for “regulatory dumping.” This study underscores the need for global cooperation – through harmonized standards or trade-linked enforcement – to prevent cross-border displacement of dietary risks. Beyond TF, the findings offer timely insights for emerging national and global mandates on other nutrients, such as salt, sugar, and saturated fats.
records.abstract_cn: 国家营养法规可以通过两种不同方式影响饮食：直接通过国内政策机制，以及间接通过调节贸易流动。本研究评估反式脂肪（TF）摄入受到这两条路径的影响。当各国单独采取行动——通过禁止或限制TF——其法规在时间、严格程度和执行力度上常常存在差异。这种监管异质性可能导致漏洞，使不健康产品得以跨境流动。本研究通过构建161国家（2010-2022，采用已建立的基准验证）食品项目层面的面板数据集，并结合分段差异中的差异法与中介分析，估算TF法规对其国内摄入的因果效应。结果显示，像美国和欧盟那样的严格、可执行的法规显著降低了TF的摄入和进口，起到了有效过滤富含TF食品的作用。相反，法规较弱的国家进口和摄入量逐步上升，最终增加摄入，实际上使其面临成为“饮食风险避风港”的风险。即使是温和的法规，在强有力的监测支持下也能取得更好的效果。这些结果对控制进口国特定的外国监管暴露等替代规格的稳健性检验均保持一致。因果证据表明，单边行动能带来显著的健康改善，但碎片化的监管方式也为“监管倾销”提供了机会。本文强调需要通过协调标准或与贸易挂钩的执法实现全球合作，以防止跨境饮食风险的转移。除了反式脂肪外，这些发现为新兴国家和全球范围内关于盐、糖和饱和脂肪等其他营养素的法规制定提供了及时的见解。

records.title_en: Fostering legume purchases with behavioural interventions: evidence from field experiments in online and offline supermarkets
records.title_cn: 通过行为干预促进豆类购买：来自线上与线下超市的实地实验证据
records.abstract_en: The protein transition is a crucial element of the transition to sustainable food systems, and both EU and national policies aim to foster the consumption of plant-based proteins. Supermarkets as the primary source of food products in many countries represent a promising environment for translating these policy objectives into practice. With three studies from Denmark, including a representative online survey (n = 838 participants) followed by randomised controlled trials in a real online supermarket in two rounds over 6 weeks (n = 9,093 transactions Round 1; n = 8,706 transactions Round 2) and field experiments in physical brick-and-mortar stores (9 test stores, 13 control stores, 21 days of observation), this research investigates the potential of leveraging behavioural interventions to foster legume purchases in online and offline retail settings. The randomised controlled trials in the online supermarket showed that placement interventions in the vegetable section were effective in increasing sales of legumes by 57%, while placement interventions in the meat section were not effective, suggesting that the strategies known to work for highly processed plant-based meat substitutes cannot be translated to legumes. The field experiments in brick-and-mortar supermarkets confirmed that the vegetable section is a promising intervention point. The multi-layered intervention tested (bundling placement combined with a recipe inspiration poster) significantly increased legume purchases to a similar degree as in the other study.
records.abstract_cn: 蛋白质转型是实现可持续食品体系转型的关键要素，欧盟及各国政策均致力于促进植物蛋白的消费。超市作为许多国家食品产品的主要来源，是将这些政策目标转化为实践的有前景的环境。本文基于丹麦的三项研究，包括一项具有代表性的线上问卷调查（n = 838名参与者），随后在真实线上超市中分两轮、为期6周的随机对照试验（第9,093轮n = 1笔交易；第8,706轮n = 2笔交易），以及在线下实体门店的实地实验（9家实验门店，13家对照门店，21天观察），探讨了在线上与线下零售环境中利用行为干预促进豆类购买的潜力。线上超市的随机对照试验显示，在蔬菜区进行陈列干预能有效提升豆类销量57%，而在肉类区的陈列干预则无效，表明已知对高度加工的植物基肉类替代品有效的策略并不能直接应用于豆类。线下实体超市的实地实验进一步证实，蔬菜区是有前景的干预点。多层次干预（陈列捆绑结合菜谱启发海报）显著提升了豆类购买，提升幅度与其他研究相当。

records.title_en: Viewpoint: evaluating transparency and market consequences of the national bioengineered food disclosure standard in the United States
records.title_cn: 观点：评估美国国家生物工程食品披露标准的透明度及市场后果
records.abstract_en: The 2018 National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS) mandated disclosure of bioengineered (BE) ingredients in regulated foods in the United States, with full compliance required by January 2022. The policy is intended to reduce information asymmetry by enabling consumers to infer BE status through mandatory labeling, alongside existing voluntary claims such as organic and non-GMO labels. This viewpoint paper concludes that the current design and implementation of the NBFDS do not fully support this transparency objective in practice. We show that several regulatory features weaken the inference mechanism linking disclosure to consumer understanding on which the policy relies, including evolving definition and terminology associated with BE foods, electronic and digital disclosure options, detectability-based exclusions for highly refined products, exemptions from mandatory disclosure, and limited ingredient specificity. As a result, under the current design, mandatory BE labeling increases consumer search costs and cognitive burden while creating implementation challenges for industry. These findings underscore the importance of careful policy design in achieving effective transparency. Continued evaluation and evidence-based refinement are needed to improve the effectiveness of the law.
records.abstract_cn: 2018年的国家生物工程食品披露标准（NBFDS）要求在美国对受管制食品中披露生物工程（BE）成分，全面合规截止日期为2022年一月。该政策旨在通过强制性标签披露，使消费者能够推断BE状态，从而减少信息不对称，同时还有现有的自愿声明，如有机和非转基因标签。本观点论文得出结论，NBFDS的当前设计和实施在实践中并未完全支持这一透明度目标。我们表明，几项监管特征削弱了披露与消费者理解之间的推断机制，这是政策依赖的，包括与BE食品相关的不断演变的定义和术语、电子和数字披露选项、对高度精制产品的检测性排除、强制披露豁免以及有限的成分特定性。因此，在当前设计下，强制性BE标签增加了消费者的搜索成本和认知负担，同时为行业带来了实施挑战。这些发现强调了在实现有效透明度时仔细政策设计的重要性。需要持续评估和基于证据的改进，以提高法律的有效性。

records.title_en: Digital literacy training to promote diffusion of digital agricultural tools to smallholder farmers: evidence from a randomized intervention in Egypt
records.title_cn: 数字素养培训促进数字农业工具在小农户中的推广：埃及随机干预的证据
records.abstract_en: Despite growing enthusiasm about the potential of digital innovations to transform agrifood systems, adoption among smallholder farmers in Africa remains low and heterogeneous. While the proliferation of digital tools targeting smallholder farmers is encouraging, the vast majority remain at pilot stages, facing barriers such as limited awareness among farmer, digital illiteracy, usability challenges, and low trust among farmers. This paper evaluates alternative digital literacy interventions designed to address these demand-side barriers and enhance smallholder farmers’ knowledge, utilization, trust, and uptake of two Egyptian mobile apps offering marketing, advisory, and input delivery services. Following a Training of Trainers (TOT) model, we designed and implemented a randomized controlled trial to test three variants of digital literacy training: standard classroom-based digital literacy training (T1), digital training complemented (preceded) by a video-based play (T2), digital training complemented (preceded) by a live community play (T3), and a control group (C). We find that the different variants of digital training led to statistically significant increases in uptake and utilization of digital tools. Specifically, the standard digital training alone increased uptake by 20 percentage points and utilization by 18 percentage points. The interventions also improved farmers’ trust in digital tools by 8–13 percentage points. Surprisingly, for some outcomes, the digital literacy training alone outperformed the combined approaches that incorporated edutainment nudges. We explore possible explanations, including group size effects and social influence dynamics during the plays. We also document heterogeneity in the impact of these interventions across farmers’ gender and age. Our findings offer insights into designing cost-effective, scalable interventions that build digital capabilities and trust among smallholder farmers, while cautioning against assuming edutainment always strengthens adoption outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管对数字创新有望变革农产品系统的潜力日益热衷，但非洲小农户的采用率仍然较低且存在异质性。虽然针对小农户的数字工具的普及令人鼓舞，但绝大多数仍处于试点阶段，面临诸如农户认知有限、数字素养不足、可用性挑战以及农户信任度低等障碍。本文评估旨在解决这些需求侧障碍、提升小农户对提供市场营销、咨询和投入配送服务的埃及二移动应用的认知、利用、信任和采纳的数字素养干预措施。采用培训师培训（TOT）模式，我们设计并实施了一项随机对照试验，测试三数字素养培训的不同变体：标准的课堂数字素养培训（T1）、在数字培训前辅以视频播放（T2）、在数字培训前辅以现场社区剧（T3），以及对照组（C）。研究发现，不同的数字培训变体在提升数字工具的采纳和利用方面具有统计学显著性。具体而言，单独的标准数字培训使采纳率提高了20个百分点，利用率提高了18个百分点。这些干预措施还使农户对数字工具的信任度提高了8-13个百分点。令人惊讶的是，在某些结果中，单一的数字素养培训优于结合娱乐教育元素的多种干预方式。我们探讨了可能的解释，包括小组规模效应和剧中社会影响动力学。我们还记录了这些干预措施在不同性别和年龄农户中的异质性影响。我们的研究结果为设计具有成本效益、可扩展的干预措施提供了见解，旨在提升小农户的数字能力和信任，同时提醒不要假设娱乐教育元素总能增强采纳效果。

records.title_en: Does school lunch equalize? An examination of dietary quality and socioeconomic disparities in Germany
records.title_cn: 学校午餐能否实现平衡？德国饮食质量与社会经济差异的检验
records.abstract_en: An adequate diet is essential for children’s cognitive, physical, and educational development, yet children from lower socioeconomic backgrounds are more likely to have poorer dietary quality, reinforcing social inequalities. This study examines whether the offer of school lunch can mitigate the effect of socioeconomic status on children’s total daily dietary quality. Using food frequency data from the second wave of the German KiGGS study (2014–2017), we construct an updated Healthy Nutrition Score for Kids and Youth (HuSKY) to capture overall dietary quality in a single measure. We focus on children between 6 and 13 years and proxy school lunch using attendance at after-school care facilities that typically offer school lunch. To address potential selection bias between children with and without such a lunch offer, we apply propensity score matching. We then estimate a mixed-effects model on the matched sample (n = 2,212) to analyze the effects of socioeconomic status, school lunch offer, and their interaction on total daily dietary quality. Our results corroborate that dietary quality is higher among children with higher socioeconomic status and is also positively associated with receiving a school lunch offer. Beyond supporting prior findings, we find that the positive association between socioeconomic status and dietary quality is substantially weaker among children receiving a school lunch offer. Accordingly, we conclude that school lunch may help reduce socioeconomic disparities in dietary quality. Future research should examine whether these improvements help reduce broader inequalities in health, education, and income. Policymakers should consider these potential benefits in the ongoing debate surrounding (free) school lunch provision.
records.abstract_cn: 充足的饮食对儿童的认知、身体和教育发展至关重要，然而来自较低社会经济背景的儿童更可能拥有较差的饮食质量，从而加剧社会不平等。本研究考察学校午餐的提供是否能够减轻社会经济地位对儿童每日总饮食质量的影响。利用德国KiGGS研究（第二）中2014-2017波段的食物频率数据，我们构建了更新的儿童与青少年健康营养评分（HuSKY），以单一指标反映整体饮食质量。研究对象为6至13年龄段的儿童，利用通常提供学校午餐的课后照料机构的出席情况作为学校午餐的代理变量。为应对有无学校午餐提供的儿童之间可能存在的选择偏差，我们采用倾向得分匹配方法。在匹配样本（样本量为2,212）上，应用混合效应模型估算社会经济地位、学校午餐提供及其交互作用对每日总饮食质量的影响。结果显示，社会经济地位较高的儿童饮食质量较好，且接受学校午餐的儿童饮食质量也呈正相关。除支持先前的研究发现外，我们还发现，社会经济地位与饮食质量之间的正向关系在接受学校午餐的儿童中显著减弱。因此，我们得出结论，学校午餐可能有助于减少饮食质量方面的社会经济差异。未来的研究应探讨这些改善是否有助于缩小健康、教育和收入等更广泛的不平等。政策制定者应在关于（免费）学校午餐提供的持续辩论中考虑这些潜在的益处。

records.title_en: Defaults harmonize our food choices – a systematic data review of default effects across socio-demographic groups
records.title_cn: 默认设置协调我们的食品选择——一项关于不同社会人口群体默认效应的系统数据综述
records.abstract_en: Food policy often struggles to reach diverse population groups, and well-intentioned interventions can sometimes exacerbate inequalities along socio-demographic groups. This systematic data review examines whether default nudges in food choices have consistent effects across different socio-demographic groups, or whether their impact varies depending on factors such as education level, age, and gender. After selecting eligible studies, authors from 12 studies shared their primary data and were subsequently included in the Default Nudge Research & Data Sharing Consortium (Table A2). These primary data enabled us to analyze 40 interaction effects examining whether age, gender, and education moderate the effectiveness of defaults relative to active choice conditions. Results show no consistent and rarely any interaction effects, suggesting defaults influence food decisions similarly across socio-demographic groups. A possible exception is that harmful defaults may be more effective among less educated individuals. These findings highlight default nudges as a broadly equitable behavioral tool in food policy design.
records.abstract_cn: 食品政策常常难以覆盖多样化的人口群体，善意的干预措施有时可能加剧沿社会人口群体的差异。本系统数据综述考察了食品选择中的默认引导是否在不同社会人口群体中具有一致的效果，或其影响是否因教育水平、年龄和性别等因素而异。在筛选符合条件的研究后，来自12研究的作者共享了他们的原始数据，并随后被纳入默认引导研究与数据共享联盟（表A2）。这些原始数据使我们能够分析40交互作用，检验年龄、性别和教育是否调节默认设置相对于主动选择条件的有效性。结果显示没有一致且几乎没有交互作用，表明默认设置在不同社会人口群体中对食品决策的影响类似。一个可能的例外是，有害的默认设置在教育程度较低的个体中可能更为有效。这些发现强调了默认引导作为一种广泛公平的行为工具在食品政策设计中的作用。

records.title_en: Impact of gardening and nutrition support provided to women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 为孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔难民营妇女提供园艺和营养支持的影响
records.abstract_en: Nearly one million Rohingya refugees, displaced by the Myanmar civil war, live in densely populated camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh. While food aid addresses some of their immediate needs, additional solutions are necessary to foster self-reliance, as many have been living in camps for years with little hope of returning home. Gardening is one approach that could enhance diets, food security, and incomes, but evidence for the impact of home garden programs in refugee camps remains limited. The objective of this study is to evaluate the impact of a home garden and nutrition program on the diets and food security of pregnant and lactating women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar. A cluster-randomized controlled trial was conducted, with pre- and post-intervention data collected from 1050 women, evenly split into control and treatment groups. A difference-in-differences estimator was used to measure the intent-to-treat effects. Lack of space was the primary obstacle to gardening, but sack gardens and rooftop gardens offered solutions. Women reported many benefits from gardening beyond food consumption, such as personal joy and making the house look nice. The intervention led to a 17-percentage point increase in garden adoption (p = 0.018) and a 57-percentage point rise in households sourcing fruits and vegetables from their gardens (p < 0.001). It also improved nutrition knowledge by 23 percentage points (p < 0.001) and household food security by 66% (p < 0.05). The intervention led to a significant increase of 1 additional serving of fruit per week, but there was no significant increase in vegetable intake. These findings clearly show the benefits of providing gardening and nutrition training to nutritionally vulnerable women in densely populated refugee camps.
records.abstract_cn: 近一百万因缅甸内战流离失所的罗兴亚难民居住在孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔人口密集的难民营中。虽然粮食援助解决了部分他们的即时需求，但由于许多人已在营地生活多年且几乎没有回家的希望，仍需额外方案以促进自力更生。园艺是一种能够改善饮食、粮食安全和收入的方法，但关于家庭园艺项目在难民营影响的证据仍有限。本研究旨在评估家庭园艺和营养项目对科克斯巴扎尔难民营孕妇和哺乳期妇女饮食和粮食安全的影响。采用集群随机对照试验，干预前后共收集了1050名妇女的数据，控制组和干预组人数均等。使用双重差分估计量测量意向性处理效应。空间不足是园艺的主要障碍，但袋式花园和屋顶花园提供了解决方案。妇女们报告园艺带来的诸多益处，除了食物消费外，还包括个人愉悦和美化家园。干预使园艺采纳率提高了17个百分点（p = 0.018），家庭从自家园艺获取水果和蔬菜的比例上升了57个百分点（p < 0.001）。此外，营养知识提升了23个百分点（p < 0.001），家庭粮食安全提高了66%（p < 0.05）。干预显著增加了每周水果摄入量1份，但蔬菜摄入量无显著增加。这些结果清楚显示，在人口密集的难民营为营养脆弱妇女提供园艺和营养培训具有明显益处。

records.title_en: Long Wars
records.title_cn: 长期战争
records.abstract_en: We study whether the Coase conjecture holds for bargaining during war. Two players, A and B, contest a divisible resource until one side collapses or agreement is reached. If player B is militarily strong, then he insists on getting a large share. However, player A only concedes this large share if player B credibly signals his strength by fighting a sufficiently long war. Thus, the Coase conjecture fails, and asymmetric information about military strength explains why long wars may be inevitable. Using a mechanism design approach, we derive a lower bound on the expected duration of war.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究科斯猜想对于战争期间的讨价还价是否成立。 二 玩家 A 和 B 争夺可分割的资源，直到 一 一方崩溃或达成协议。如果玩家B军事实力雄厚，那么他就坚持要获得大量份额。然而，只有当玩家 B 通过进行足够长的战争来可信地表明自己的实力时，玩家 A 才会承认这么大的份额。因此，科斯猜想失败了，军事实力信息不对称解释了为什么长期战争可能不可避免。使用机制设计方法，我们得出了预期战争持续时间的下限。

records.title_en: Different Paths to College Success: The Impact of Massachusetts's Charter Schools on College Trajectories
records.title_cn: 大学成功的不同途径：马萨诸塞州特许学校对大学轨迹的影响
records.abstract_en: The charter school movement encompasses many school models. In Massachusetts in the 2010s, the site of our study, urban charter schools primarily used "No Excuses" practices, whereas nonurban charters had greater model variety. Using randomized admissions lotteries, we estimate the impact of charter schools by locality on college preparation, enrollment, and graduation. Urban charter schools boost all of these outcomes. Nonurban charter schools raise college enrollment and graduation despite reducing state test scores and AP enrollment. Notably, the nonurban charter college graduation edge is more than twice as large as that from urban charter attendance.
records.abstract_cn: 特许学校运动包含许多学校模式。在马萨诸塞州的 2010（我们的研究地点），城市特许学校主要采用“无借口”做法，而非城市特许学校则有更多的模式多样性。通过随机录取抽签，我们估计了各地特许学校对大学准备、入学和毕业的影响。城市特许学校促进了所有这些成果。尽管州考试成绩和 AP 入学率有所下降，但非城市特许学校仍提高了大学入学率和毕业率。值得注意的是，非城市特许大学的毕业优势是城市特许大学毕业优势的两倍多。

records.title_en: Work from Home and Disability Employment
records.title_cn: 在家工作和残疾人就业
records.abstract_en: There has been a dramatic rise in disability employment since the pandemic, while work from home (WFH) has risen fourfold. This paper asks whether the two are causally related. Controlling for compositional changes and labor market tightness, a 1 percentage point increase in WFH increases full-time employment by 1.0 percent for individuals with a physical disability. The postpandemic increase in working from home explains 68-85 percent of the rise in full-time employment. Wage data suggest that WFH increased the supply of workers with a physical disability, likely by reducing commuting costs and enabling better control of working conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 自大流行以来，残疾人就业人数急剧增加，而在家工作（WFH）则增加了四倍。本文询问 二 是否存在因果关系。在控制了构成变化和劳动力市场紧张的情况下，在家办公的 1 个百分点会增加身体残疾者的全职就业率（1.0%）。大流行后在家工作的增加解释了 68-85% 全职就业人数的增加。工资数据表明，在家办公增加了身体残疾工人的供应，这可能是通过降低通勤成本和更好地控制工作条件来实现的。

records.title_en: The Impact of Unions on the Wage Distribution: Evidence from Higher Education
records.title_cn: 工会对工资分配的影响：来自高等教育的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of unionization on the wage distribution of Canadian university faculty using longitudinal administrative data on salaries and exploiting the staggered rollout of unionization across institutions. We find that unionization compressed salaries: Wages at the bottom of the unconditional distribution increased by roughly 10 percent, while wages at the top were unaffected. Our evidence suggests that these distributional impacts were driven by the introduction of contractual salary floors. We also estimate little impact of unionization on faculty employment. Instead, our results suggest that the increase in universities' wage bills was financed by an increase in student enrollment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用纵向工资管理数据并利用跨机构工会化的交错推出，估计了工会化对加拿大大学教员工资分配的影响。我们发现工会压缩了工资：无条件分配底层的工资大约增加了10%，而顶层的工资不受影响。我们的证据表明，这些分配影响是由合同工资下限的引入所驱动的。我们还估计工会化对教师就业的影响不大。相反，我们的结果表明，大学工资的增加是通过学生入学率的增加来提供资金的。

records.title_en: An Evolutionary Perspective on Updating Risk and Ambiguity Preferences
records.title_cn: 更新风险和模糊性偏好的进化视角
records.abstract_en: Using an evolutionary approach, we address the prominent tension in the literature that updating of ambiguity and nonexpected-utility preferences cannot, in general, be both dynamically consistent and consequentialist. Perhaps not surprisingly, evolutionary optimality requires dynamic consistency. The more subtle insight is the evolutionary optimality of systematic violations of consequentialism. We base our investigation on the model of adaptive preferences (Sadowski and Sarver 2024), which generalizes the model of Robson (1996) and nests variants of many well-known models in the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 使用进化方法，我们解决了文献中的突出矛盾，即模糊性和非预期效用偏好的更新一般不能既动态一致又结果主义。也许并不奇怪，进化最优性需要动态一致性。更微妙的见解是系统性违反结果论的进化最优性。我们的研究基于自适应偏好模型（Sadowski 和 Sarver 2024），该模型概括了 Robson 模型（1996）并嵌套了文献中许多知名模型的变体。

records.title_en: Breaking Bad News
records.title_cn: 突发坏消息
records.abstract_en: We study how information disclosure shapes social learning about a potentially harmful product. Increased transparency helps early agents avoid harm, which may undermine learning by later agents. Despite this conflict of interest, we show that full transparency is uniquely optimal for all agents when they learn only by observing neighbors' harm. We investigate whether full transparency about harm continues to benefit all agents when they also learn from additional, imperfect signals.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究信息披露如何影响对潜在有害产品的社会认知。增加透明度有助于早期智能体避免伤害，这可能会破坏后来智能体的学习。尽管存在这种利益冲突，但我们表明，当所有智能体仅通过观察邻居的伤害来学习时，完全透明对于它们来说是唯一的最佳选择。我们调查当所有主体也从额外的、不完美的信号中学习时，对伤害的完全透明是否会继续使他们受益。

records.title_en: Taxing the Wealth of the Poor: Evidence from the Danish Old-Age Support Asset Test
records.title_cn: 对穷人的财富征税：来自丹麦老年支持资产测试的证据
records.abstract_en: We document strong behavioral responses to an asset test for an old-age support program in Denmark using comprehensive administrative data. We show that the density distribution of the liquid assets targeted by the test exhibits large but diffuse excess mass below the threshold for the treated group relative to control groups of comparable but ineligible individuals. A cohort analysis exploiting the panel structure suggests that the program reduces liquid assets by 20 percent around the threshold. Analyzing high-frequency bank data on assets and cash withdrawals shows that the excess mass around the threshold largely reflects permanent rather than temporary responses.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用综合管理数据记录了对丹麦老年支持计划资产测试的强烈行为反应。我们表明，相对于可比较但不合格的个体的对照组，测试目标的流动资产的密度分布表现出较大但分散的过量质量，低于治疗组的阈值。利用面板结构进行的队列分析表明，该计划将流动资产减少了阈值附近的 20%。分析有关资产和现金提取的高频银行数据表明，阈值附近的过剩量很大程度上反映了永久性而非暂时性的反应。

records.title_en: Survivors' Mental Health and the Protective Role of Income Stability
records.title_cn: 幸存者的心理健康和收入稳定的保护作用
records.abstract_en: We use administrative records on the universe of Danish households to characterize survivors' mental health following their spouse's death. We provide visually clear evidence for the immediate, large, and lingering adverse impacts and focus on studying the role of income security in driving the immediate effects. We find that, for both males and females, a large share of the spike in the take-up of mental health medication upon spousal death can be explained by the income loss imposed by the shock. Our results imply that safety net policies can improve survivors' mental health via the immediate liquidity they provide.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用丹麦家庭的行政记录来描述幸存者在配偶去世后的心理健康状况。我们为直接、巨大和持久的不利影响提供直观清晰的证据，并重点研究收入保障在推动直接影响方面的作用。我们发现，对于男性和女性来说，配偶死亡后心理健康药物使用量的激增很大程度上可以归因于冲击造成的收入损失。我们的结果表明，安全网政策可以通过提供即时流动性来改善幸存者的心理健康。

records.title_en: Data-Driven Investors
records.title_cn: 数据驱动的投资者
records.abstract_en: How does the increased use of data technologies, like machine learning, by financial intermediaries affect the allocation of capital towards innovation? I study this question in the context of startup financing by venture capitalists (VCs). While VCs adopting data technologies become better at screening startups similar to those in historical data, they tilt their investments towards this pool and become concurrently less likely to finance innovative startups that achieve rare major success. Plausibly exogenous variations in VCs’ screening automation suggest that these effects are causal. These findings highlight how investors’ adoption of data technologies can have real effects through innovation financing.
records.abstract_cn: 金融中介机构越来越多地使用机器学习等数据技术，如何影响创新的资本配置？我在风险投资家（VC）启动融资的背景下研究这个问题。虽然采用数据技术的风险投资公司能够更好地筛选与历史数据中类似的初创公司，但他们将投资转向这一池，同时也不太可能为那些取得罕见重大成功的创新初创公司提供资金。风险投资公司筛选自动化的外生变化似乎表明这些影响是因果关系。这些发现凸显了投资者对数据技术的采用如何通过创新融资产生真正的影响。

records.title_en: Gender Stereotypes and Entrepreneur Financing
records.title_cn: 性别刻板印象与企业家融资
records.abstract_en: I document a significant gender gap in entrepreneurs’ access to early-stage equity financing. Using unique administrative data on French startups, I show that this gap is particularly pronounced in male-dominated sectors. Controlling for a comprehensive set of entrepreneur and startup characteristics—including demographics, backgrounds, and motivations—accounts for 42% of the average gender gap. However, in male-dominated sectors, 80% of the gap remains unexplained. Growth-oriented female entrepreneurs rely more heavily on bank loans, substituting equity with debt. Finally, VC-backed female-founded startups outperform their male counterparts in male-dominated sectors. These findings suggest that context-dependent stereotypes influence equity financing decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 我记录了企业家在获得早期股权融资方面存在显着的性别差距。通过使用法国初创企业的独特管理数据，我发现这种差距在男性主导的行业中尤为明显。控制一系列全面的企业家和初创企业特征（包括人口统计、背景和动机）可以解释平均性别差距的42%。然而，在男性主导的行业，80%的差距仍然无法解释。以增长为导向的女性企业家更加依赖银行贷款，以债务代替股权。最后，在男性主导的行业中，由风险投资支持的女性创办的初创公司的表现优于男性同行。这些发现表明，与背景相关的刻板印象会影响股权融资决策。

records.title_en: The Broader Role of Venture Capital Due Diligence
records.title_cn: 风险投资尽职调查的更广泛作用
records.abstract_en: Analyzing approximately 2,000 applicants to a U.K. seed fund, this study examines how venture capital (VC) due diligence affects startup outcomes independent of funding decisions. Leveraging random reviewer assignment, we find that due diligence increases 2-year growth but lowers continuation rates among nonfunded applicants, reflecting a dynamic of accelerated scaling or exit. Evidence points to a learning mechanism: due diligence exposes founders to advanced website technologies, prompting capability building in digital skills. Firms selected for due diligence adopt these technologies, even before raising external capital. The findings highlight VC due diligence as a formative process influencing startups beyond the funded few.
records.abstract_cn: 这项研究分析了大约 2,000 家英国种子基金的申请人，探讨了风险投资 (VC) 尽职调查如何影响独立于融资决策的初创公司结果。利用随机评审员分配，我们发现尽职调查增加了2年增长率，但降低了未获得资助的申请人的继续率，反映了加速扩展或退出的动态。证据表明了一种学习机制：尽职调查让创始人接触先进的网站技术，促进数字技能的能力建设。被选中进行尽职调查的公司甚至在筹集外部资本之前就采用了这些技术。调查结果强调，风险投资尽职调查是一个影响初创企业的形成过程，而不仅仅是少数获得资助的初创企业。

records.title_en: Collateral Effects: The Role of FinTech in Small Business Lending
records.title_cn: 附带影响：金融科技在小企业贷款中的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of introducing junior unsecured loans (i.e., FinTech loans) into the small business lending market. Using French administrative data, we find that firms experience a 13% increase in bank credit after receiving a FinTech loan. We use propensity score matching procedures and a shift-share instrument to account for credit demand. The credit increase only occurs when FinTech borrowers invest in new assets, and Fintech borrowers are subsequently more likely to pledge collateral to banks. This suggests that firms use FinTech loans to acquire assets that they then pledge to banks, thereby increasing total borrowing capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了将初级无担保贷款（即金融科技贷款）引入小企业贷款市场的影响。使用法国行政数据，我们发现企业在获得金融科技贷款后银行信贷增加 13%。我们使用倾向评分匹配程序和转移份额工具来考虑信贷需求。只有当金融科技借款人投资新资产时，信贷才会增加，而金融科技借款人随后更有可能向银行质押抵押品。这表明企业利用金融科技贷款来获取资产，然后将其抵押给银行，从而提高总借贷能力。

records.title_en: Asset Overhang and Technological Change
records.title_cn: 资产过剩和技术变革
records.abstract_en: Investors face reduced incentives to finance technological change that devalues their legacy investments. We formalize this “asset overhang” and apply our framework to the climate-banking nexus. Leveraging (1) firm-level data on green innovation and diffusion and (2) the sets of product and technology market peers, we implement a shift-share design that identifies banks’ credit facilities impacted by green firm activities. We find that green firms imposing an asset overhang across all lenders are 3 to 7 percentage points more likely to report tight credit supply conditions. The presence of legacy-free investors mitigates the asset overhang problem, thereby facilitating technological change.
records.abstract_cn: 投资者为技术变革提供资金的动力减少，从而导致其遗留投资贬值。我们将这种“资产过剩”正式化，并将我们的框架应用于气候银行关系。利用（1）公司层面的绿色创新和扩散数据以及（2）产品和技术市场同行的数据，我们实施了一种转移共享设计，以确定受绿色公司活动影响的银行信贷安排。我们发现，向所有贷方施加资产过剩的绿色企业更有可能报告信贷供应紧张状况 3 至 7 个百分点。无遗产投资者的存在缓解了资产过剩问题，从而促进了技术变革。

records.title_en: Excess Commitment in RD
records.title_cn: 研发方面的超额投入
records.abstract_en: We document that firms exhibit “excess” commitment to R&D projects and examine its consequences for innovation outcomes. Using detailed data on pharmaceutical firms’ clinical trial projects, we find that trial delays, empirically uncorrelated with multiple project-quality measures, substantially reduce firms’ subsequent project-termination propensity. This result remains robust when we use variation in clinical trial site congestion to instrument for unexpected delays. Excess commitment intensifies when CEO compensation has greater stock-price sensitivity and the CEO is responsible for the project’s initiation.
